fragments.text: Hello everyone, my name is Andrés Bulbano. I am originally from Colombia, currently. I'm an associate professor at the School of Arts and Humanities at the Open University of Catalonia in Barcelona, Spain. I consider myself a media scholar, mainly interested in the history of media technologies and a media artist as well. Currently, I'm involved in a research project that is related to the topic of this conference and it spins around the historicity of computational technologies in Latin America. And, of course, these days, this history of technology is related to artificial intelligence. So I'm going to pose that question if it is even possible to ask about AI in our atmosphere, in our lightages, and on how this story should be told.
fragments.summary: I'm an associate professor at the School of Arts and Humanities at the Open University of Catalonia in Barcelona, Spain.
